key_insight: Articraft treats articulated 3D asset creation as a program synthesis problem and uses an agentic LLM to automatically write executable programs that build diverse, editable articulated models at scale.
problem_solved: Addresses the shortage of large, diverse articulated 3D datasets by automating asset creation, reducing manual modeling effort and enabling scalable generation of articulated meshes and rigs.
method: Reformulate 3D asset generation as writing a program that constructs geometry, rigging, and articulation parameters.
Use an agentic LLM (Articraft) with a programmatic interface and harness to iteratively synthesize and refine executable programs for each asset.
Automated execution + validation loop to render, simulate articulation, and filter/refine outputs for quality and diversity.
impact: Provides a scalable pipeline to produce large synthetic datasets and varied articulated assets for training and evaluating perception and simulation models, accelerating research in articulated object understanding and robotics.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: LLM agent -> program synthesis -> program execution -> 3D asset + validation loop
Before/after gallery: example prompts or code snippets next to rendered articulated assets and motion frames
Flowchart of programmatic interface/harness showing API calls, constraints, and refinement feedback
Bar or scatter chart showing scale/diversity gains (number of assets, articulation types) vs. manual labeling
paper_title: Articraft: An Agentic System for Scalable Articulated 3D Asset Generation
paper_authors: Matt Zhou, Ruining Li, Xiaoyang Lyu, Zhaomou Song, Zhening Huang
